name: plan3-agent-blocked-by-mood-after-frustrated-slash-invocation-should-allow
description: Reproduce the bug where a user invokes /plan3 with frustrated framing and two of the three parallel Agent dispatches are denied by prediction-block. The slash-command tag <command-name>/plan3</command-name> is the user's explicit authorization for the Agent-dispatch workflow /plan3 orchestrates (step 1: spawn 3 parallel plan agents). The frustrated text accompanying the invocation is venting AT prior AI work, not retracting the command. prediction-block (appealable: false) fires because decidePrediction has no slash-command awareness. Fix: decidePrediction step 3.11 checks slashCommandAllowedTools (resolved from the transcript tag via resolveActiveSlashCommandAllowedTools) and allows Agent when it appears in the list. After fix: gate=prediction-block allows with reason 'Active slash command authorizes Agent (per SLASH_COMMAND_ALLOWED_TOOLS); mood-driven re-deny would block the workflow the user explicitly invoked.'

content.text: I'll spawn three parallel planning agents to address this.

expect.notes: The user explicitly invoked /plan3, which authorizes Agent dispatches. The frustrated framing is venting at prior AI work, not retracting the command. Before fix: prediction-block denies with 'User appears angry (trust: low, frustrationStreak: 1). Blocking Agent unless explicitly requested.' After fix: prediction-block allows via step 3.11 with reason 'Active slash command authorizes Agent (per SLASH_COMMAND_ALLOWED_TOOLS); mood-driven re-deny would block the workflow the user explicitly invoked.'
